nom: Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Face Wash with 2% Salicylic Acid

avis.titre: Cleared My Skin... and My Sins
avis.texte: If you’re looking for a gentle daily face scrub that feels like it’s aggressively judging your life choices, then congratulations—you’ve found it. The Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Scrub is not just a face wash; it’s an experience. First Impressions: The bottle promises “2% Salicylic Acid Acne Treatment,” which sounds fancy and medical. But let me tell you, that 2% feels like it’s doing 200% of the work. The moment it hits your face, you’ll wonder if you’re cleansing your pores or sanding down a vintage coffee table. The microbeads don’t exfoliate—they interrogate. Application: It’s like your face is getting a motivational speech from a drill sergeant: "THIS ACNE? UNACCEPTABLE." "YOUR SKIN TEXTURE? WEAK!" "WE ARE NOT LEAVING UNTIL EVERY PORE IS ACCOUNTED FOR!" At first, I thought I was imagining it. But every morning, my face felt smoother and slightly less guilty about existing. The Results: The acne? Gone. The oil? Obliterated. My soul? Also slightly exfoliated, but hey—who needs emotional stability when your skin looks this good? I swear my pores are now so clean they sparkle. I look like I’m glowing, and not just because of the mild irritation I felt the first couple of days. Side Effects: Did it sting a little? Yes. Did I question my entire skincare routine and contemplate my life choices? Absolutely. Would I still slather this on my face daily like a desperate pilgrim seeking absolution? Without hesitation. I think it helps dry out the acne and get rid of any oils. It DOES NOT dry out my skin or hair, which is nice.

Es perfecto, super suave y delicado para la piel, te deja una sensacion de suavidad y limpieza profunda
Es un excelente producto, limpia y exfolia muy bien. No tengo quejas después de meses de usarlo. Mi piel es grasa y no me generó acné o alguna alergia. Deja la piel muy suave.

Me encanta porque limpia con profundidad. Padezco mucho punto negro y granitos, limpia perfectamente y quita la oleosidad. Las partes más sensibles de mi rostro es a los lados de la nariz, pómulos y barbilla, siento un ardor al aplicar el producto siempre que tengo maleza. Tengo dos meses que lo compre y lo uso cada tercer día, aun no se me termina. Lo recomiendo muchísimo, definitivamente mi exfoliante favorito 10/10✅ comparado con los de clinique.

avis.titre: Depende de tu tipo de piel.
avis.texte: Quiero escribir esto para la persona que tiene acné y que está buscando un producto para quitarselo y quiero que sepas que dependiendo del estado de tu piel y el nivel en el que está tu acné, si tu piel es grasa y tu acné es leve o casi moderado te puedo decir que este producto sin lugar a dudas te ayudará en gran medida pero hay que ser realistas, debes de ser paciente y esperar. Por otro lado y si tú problema ves que es mas serio y que solo va aumentando te recomiendo que dejes de buscar productos de este tipo y que acudas a un dermatologo, sé muy bien que es caro pero creeme que es mejor pagar más dinero que tener cicatrices en toda tu cara, un especialista verá lo que es mejor para ti y te aseguro que saldrás de está pero recuerda que estas contra el tiempo y no debes dejarlo pasar, yo también odio esta enfermedad y por eso te doy este consejo para que tú también acabes con ella.
El mejor exfoliante, me ayuda mucho a controlar la grasa de mi cara y la.aparicion de puntos negros. Si veo diferencia en mi cuando lo uso y cuando no

Okay babes, let’s talk skincare 👏 This is my 3rd time purchasing the Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Wash now and—no gatekeeping here—it’s a game changer. This cleanser is perfect for my combo skin. It’s gentle enough for daily use but strong enough to keep those annoying breakouts in check. And it doesn’t strip my skin or cause dryness, which is major, because who wants to feel like the Sahara after washing their face? Why I’m obsessed: ✨ Oil-free (so no mid-day grease party) ✨ Contains salicylic acid—aka the acne-fighting queen ✨ Leaves my skin feeling clean, not tight ✨ Pairs beautifully with my fave moisturizer & serums Pro tip: I use it with my silicone face brush for an extra-deep cleanse and it honestly feels like a mini spa moment. 🧖‍♀️ If you're dealing with breakouts or just want a fresh, balanced glow—this is the one. 💛

El exfoliante sin aceite de Neutrogena es una excelente opción para quienes buscan una limpieza profunda sin resecar la piel. Su fórmula suave pero efectiva elimina impurezas y células muertas, ayudando a mantener los poros limpios y reduciendo la aparición de imperfecciones. Al ser libre de aceites, es ideal para pieles mixtas o grasas, dejando una sensación fresca y un acabado mate. Además, su textura ligera y agradable hace que la rutina de cuidado sea práctica y cómoda.

avis.titre: Bottle seemed partially used, but I love this face wash.
avis.texte: I really love this face wash and have been using it for many years. I found out that I can Subscribe & Save to it on Amazon so this has been a game changer for me. I was looking for a face wash that did more than cleansing. I needed something that scrubs and has some exfoliates in it that did not use plastic microbeads. I was happy that Neutrogena doesn't use plastic microbeads anymore. The scrub is nice -- fine and gritty. The exfoliators do feel a bit grainy but I like it. It does the job without feeling like I'm wiping my face with sandpaper. The scent is also really pleasant. I can't describe it, but it smells really clean. The face wash also gets a bit foamy so I feel like I am really washing my face. It also doesn't make my skin feel super dry like some other face washes do. For the price and value, I've been sticking to this one. I was a little disappointed with the product when it arrived though. It looked like half the container was empty, and there wasn't a plastic seal on it. Not sure if this was previously used, but I really hope my next order doesn't arrive like this or I may have to cancel my subscription and just purchase this at the store the old fashion way.

Run not walk I'm currently on my six tube. This scrub has helped me so much with my breakouts and the texture out my skin.... the only thing I wish they were still making the foaming version of this scrub, which was better but this still get the job done 😍
Love this exfoliating scrub! It leaves my skin super soft, smooth, and glowing without being harsh. A must-have in my routine!” ✨

avis.titre: Buyer Beware: "Formula Change" Got a completely different product.
avis.texte: Seems that Neutrogena discontinued this face wash (been using this for over a decade) and tried to say it was a "new look". The formula has completely changed, it's a thick gel now. I tried the "new version" and my face had a reaction and is now dry, red and irritated. Not sure what the closest face wash I can use now so my face isn't raw and irritated.

I like that it does not irritate my skin and I can apply other skin products after washing and pat drying my face. Although it is not a deep cleanser, it leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. Good for my skin type that is sensitive, prone to acne, and oily.
Been using is for a month my skin is 10x worse then it ever was.
